physical.title: painting; album
physical.summary:
Portrait of a woman holding an ewer; single-page painting mounted on an album folio. Woman wears long gold robe, ornately decorated with birds and trees, and a hat under her head-scarf. She holds an ewer in her left hand and a flower under her chin with her right. Ewer is decorated with a bird on a bare branch. Neutral ground with gold foliage. Plain pink and blue borders followed by a wider neutral border. Album contains forty leaves of calligraphy and paintings. 

Ink, opaque watercolour and gold on paper. Album has lacquered covers decorated with a central flower design and floral border. Concertina-style (accordian-style) binding. Reads right to left.
